_about: Synthetic adverse-media source for the SAR investigation demo. FinCrime Wire is a fictional newswire and the only source the agent may search (allowlist); every article, entity, and regulator notice here is fictional.

articles.title: State regulator warns consumers about Coinvault Exchange (fictional)
articles.summary: A fictional state regulator says Coinvault Exchange onboarded accounts without identity checks and was used to cash out P2P scam proceeds.

articles.title: Free-zone trader Bramblecoast Trading named in trade-based laundering notice (fictional)
articles.summary: A fictional regulator lists Bramblecoast Trading FZE among companies that received cash-funded wires against over-invoiced auto-parts shipments.

articles.title: Card data skimmed at online retailer Orbit Digital Goods (fictional)
articles.summary: Orbit Digital Goods confirms malicious checkout code captured card details for three weeks in September; issuers report fraud and P2P cash-out attempts.

articles.title: Title firms report wire-fraud attempts during closings (fictional)
articles.summary: Bayside Title & Escrow (fictional) stopped a spoofed wire-instruction email; the firm itself was the target, and no wrongdoing by the firm is alleged.
